title: Quran Vision Corpus (Kur'ân Vizyonu Külliyatı) v6.2.2: Bilingual 26-Step Strategic Tafsir, Maqasid & Civilization Foresight Corpus (15 Foundational Reports & 34 A4 PDFs)

description:
Quran Vision Corpus (v6.2.2) is an open-access bilingual (Turkish / English) academic corpus and interactive foresight cockpit featuring 15 foundational Quranic verse reports (QV-2026-001 to QV-2026-015) and 34 A4 PDF documents. Every monograph integrates 176 verified multi-server sources (127 Shamela + 15 Altafsir + 34 Institutional DOIs in data/sources_registry.yaml), unified 3-part Step 13 Irfani/Sufi Hermeneutics (al-Qushayri, al-Ghazali, al-Muhasibi, Sahl al-Tustari, Ibn 'Ajibah), 45 contemporary empirical datasets (APA 7 / DOI: World Bank, UNDP, WJP, UNESCO, SIPRI, OECD, WHO), 10-year Bayesian policy simulations (2026–2036), falsifiable early-warning thresholds, and 4-part 40-minute TYMM competency-based lesson plans (Step 20.1-20.4).

Release Notes (v6.2.2): v6.2.2: V16.2 Multi-Server Source Verification Registry (176/176 verified sources with 29% manual sample audit), Complete Irfani/Sufi Hermeneutics Reform across 15 monographs (Step 13), Complete TYMM Pedagogical Reform across 15 monographs (Step 20), 33rd document (ISNAD-2 Classical Arabic Databases Guide), 34th document (TYMM DKAB 15-Verse Lesson Design Guide), and compiled master corpus books.
